sources.fact: The official GOV.UK service returns rateable value for properties in England and Wales and can show calculation details and comparable properties.
2026 rateable values took effect 1 April 2026 and are based on annual rental value at the valuation date 1 April 2024; rateable value is not the rates bill.
The 2026 rating list took effect 1 April 2026 for more than two million non-domestic properties.
Official compiled-list statistics compare 2023 and 2026 rating lists by sector/geography and confirm the 2026 revaluation effective date of 1 April 2026.
The compiled statistics represent over two million business and other non-domestic valuations and are aggregate/list evidence rather than title data.
Rateable value determined by VOA provides the basis for business-rates bills and reflects rental-market evidence, not property sale value.
The official collection distinguishes the 2026 compiled list from earlier draft-list publications.
VOA defines a rateable property/hereditament as a unit of non-domestic property that is or may become liable to non-domestic rating; it is not defined as an HMLR title.
Rating-list property type derives from primary descriptions/SCat grouping and describes rating use, not planning permission or legal ownership.
VOA commonly values offices using rental comparison and net internal area, with adjustments for lease terms, fit-out and other factors.
Factories/workshops/warehouses are commonly valued using rental comparison and gross internal area; land/parking/plant may be treated separately.
VOA publishes official non-domestic rating statistics and business floorspace statistics; these aggregate releases are distinct from exact property title geometry.

examples.result: A rating-list hereditament is not assumed to equal one HMLR title or one cadastral parcel.
Rateable value is not treated as sale price, market value, rent actually paid or business-rates bill.
Primary description/property type is not treated as current planning use permission.
NIA/GIA floorspace is building valuation area and is not converted to site/parcel area.
One site may contain multiple hereditaments or one hereditament may not align to legal-title geometry; no automatic spatial dissolve/split is made.
2026 compiled-list evidence supersedes draft-list status for current rating-list context, but does not establish development status.
Comparable-property calculations are valuation evidence only and are not used to infer candidate residual land value.
No candidate promotion occurs from VOA use/value evidence without exact title relation and current planning/application evidence.
